findings.note: Rausch is lead petitioner (with Joanne M. Comerford) on S.534, an elections upgrade bill; the committee reported a new draft as S.2936 on 2026-02-09. The draft has no photo ID, citizenship-proof or voter ID rule that I found. It does cover the affidavit on an early-voting (mail) ballot envelope, permanent mail voter status, and a central voter registry that records nationality for non-citizens for street-list purposes only. Weak link to the subject: mail-ballot envelope affidavit and voter-roll content.
